1:import { RedirectStatusCode } from './redirect-status-code'
2:
3:export const REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE = 'NEXT_REDIRECT'
4:
5:export type RedirectType = 'push' | 'replace'
6:
7:export type RedirectError = Error & {
8:  digest: `${typeof REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE};${RedirectType};${string};${RedirectStatusCode};`
9:}
10:
11:/**
12: * Checks an error to determine if it's an error generated by the
13: * `redirect(url)` helper.
14: *
15: * @param error the error that may reference a redirect error
16: * @returns true if the error is a redirect error
17: */
18:export function isRedirectError(error: unknown): error is RedirectError {
19:  if (
20:    typeof error !== 'object' ||
21:    error === null ||
22:    !('digest' in error) ||
23:    typeof error.digest !== 'string'
24:  ) {
25:    return false
26:  }
27:
28:  const digest = error.digest.split(';')
29:  const [errorCode, type] = digest
30:  const destination = digest.slice(2, -2).join(';')
31:  const status = digest.at(-2)
32:
33:  const statusCode = Number(status)
34:
35:  return (
36:    errorCode === REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE &&
37:    (type === 'replace' || type === 'push') &&
38:    typeof destination === 'string' &&
39:    !isNaN(statusCode) &&
40:    statusCode in RedirectStatusCode
41:  )
42:}

1:import { RedirectStatusCode } from './redirect-status-code'
2:import {
3:  type RedirectType,
4:  type RedirectError,
5:  isRedirectError,
6:  REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE,
7:} from './redirect-error'
8:import { actionAsyncStorage } from './server-async-storage'
9:
10:export function getRedirectError(
11:  url: string,
12:  type: RedirectType,
13:  statusCode: RedirectStatusCode = RedirectStatusCode.TemporaryRedirect
14:): RedirectError {
15:  const error = new Error(REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE) as RedirectError
16:  error.digest = `${REDIRECT_ERROR_CODE};${type};${url};${statusCode};`
17:  return error
18:}
19:
20:/**
21: * This function allows you to redirect the user to another URL. It can be used in
22: * [Server Components](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/rendering/server-components),
23: * [Route Handlers](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/route-handlers), and
24: * [Server Actions](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/data-fetching/server-actions-and-mutations).
25: *
26: * - In a Server Component, this will insert a meta tag to redirect the user to the target page.
27: * - In a Route Handler, it will serve a 307 to the caller.
28: * - In a Server Action, it will perform a client-side navigation when JavaScript is available or serve a 303 for a progressive enhancement form submission.
29: * - In a Server Action, type defaults to 'push' and 'replace' elsewhere.
30: *
31: * Read more: [Next.js Docs: `redirect`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/redirect)
32: */
33:export function redirect(
34:  /** The URL to redirect to */
35:  url: string,
36:  type?: RedirectType
37:): never {
38:  type ??= actionAsyncStorage?.getStore()?.isAction ? 'push' : 'replace'
39:
40:  throw getRedirectError(url, type, RedirectStatusCode.TemporaryRedirect)
41:}
42:
43:/**
44: * This function allows you to redirect the user to another URL. It can be used in
45: * [Server Components](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/rendering/server-components),
46: * [Route Handlers](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/route-handlers), and
47: * [Server Actions](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/data-fetching/server-actions-and-mutations).
48: *
49: * - In a Server Component, this will insert a meta tag to redirect the user to the target page.
50: * - In a Route Handler, it will serve a 308 to the caller.
51: * - In a Server Action, it will perform a client-side navigation when JavaScript is available or serve a 303 for a progressive enhancement form submission.
52: *
53: * Read more: [Next.js Docs: `redirect`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/redirect)
54: */
55:export function permanentRedirect(
56:  /** The URL to redirect to */
57:  url: string,
58:  type: RedirectType = 'replace'
59:): never {
60:  throw getRedirectError(url, type, RedirectStatusCode.PermanentRedirect)
61:}
62:
63:/**
64: * Returns the encoded URL from the error if it's a RedirectError, null
65: * otherwise. Note that this does not validate the URL returned.
66: *
67: * @param error the error that may be a redirect error
68: * @return the url if the error was a redirect error
69: */
70:export function getURLFromRedirectError(error: RedirectError): string
71:export function getURLFromRedirectError(error: unknown): string | null {
72:  if (!isRedirectError(error)) return null
73:
74:  // Slices off the beginning of the digest that contains the code and the
75:  // separating ';'.
76:  return error.digest.split(';').slice(2, -2).join(';')
77:}
78:
79:export function getRedirectTypeFromError(error: RedirectError): RedirectType {
80:  if (!isRedirectError(error)) {
81:    throw new Error('Not a redirect error')
82:  }
83:
84:  return error.digest.split(';', 2)[1] as RedirectType
85:}
86:
87:export function getRedirectStatusCodeFromError(error: RedirectError): number {
88:  if (!isRedirectError(error)) {
89:    throw new Error('Not a redirect error')
90:  }
91:
92:  return Number(error.digest.split(';').at(-2))
93:}
